newsitem.title: USA: Comforce names Paterek chairman, Franco CEO.
newsitem.headline: Comforce names Paterek chairman, Franco CEO.

text.p: Comforce Corp Monday said James Paterek, one of its three founding shareholders, was elected to its board and named chairman, while Christopher Franco, also a founding shareholder, was named chief executive officer.
Previously, Paterek served as a consultant to the company. Franco, who has also been elected to Comforce's board, previously served as the company's executive vice president.
Michael Ferrentino, the third founding shareholder of Comforce, remains the company's president.
While these changes more accurately reflect the current day-to-day responsibilities of the three individuals, their duties have not changed, the company said.
Comforce provides staffing, consulting and outsourcing solutions focused on the high technology needs of the telecommunications, information technology and technical market sectors worldwide.
A company spokesman was not available for further details.
